description: This file contains functions related to processing documentation files in a multilingual translation workflow. It includes logic for reading, parsing front matter, splitting content, translating text segments, caching translations, and writing translated output files. The core function 'processFile' orchestrates reading the source file, translating its content, and saving the translated version.

methods.name: processFile
methods.description: Main function to process a documentation file: reads content, splits front matter, translates front matter sections, splits the body into segments, performs translation with caching, applies translations, encodes front matter with metadata, and writes the output to the target language directory.

methods.name: splitFrontMatter
methods.description: Splits the input content into front matter and body based on YAML front matter delimiters.

methods.name: encodeFrontMatter
methods.description: Encodes front matter data back into YAML format, adding metadata such as source path, hash, provider, etc.

methods.name: translateFrontMatter
methods.description: Translates specific front matter fields like 'summary', 'title', and 'read_when' list items if present.

methods.name: translateSnippet
methods.description: Translates a text snippet, utilizing caching for efficiency, and returning the translated string.
